description:
Azure Managed Redis registration data: the handles by which a setup-created cluster is
registered as a Frozen Redis resource. Setup owns the cluster, Alien refreshes and
heartbeats it. The access key is never carried; workloads list it from the database.

clusterResourceId.description: Full ARM resource ID of the cluster.

host.description: Endpoint host name (resolves to the private endpoint inside the VNet).

privateEndpointName.description: Private endpoint that fronts the cluster.

sku.description: SKU the cluster runs, such as `Balanced_B1`.
